displayName: DSCP-T3 CPF internal governed context packer and tests
priorAbsorption: DSCP-T3 wires DSCP-T2 type contracts into a deterministic CPF internal governed wrapper around ContextPackagerContract.pack(). No retrieval receipt runtime, provider call, or corpus ingestion is authorized.

findings.summary: GovernedContextPackerContract creates governed packages, but GovernedRetrievalReceipt remains a type-only contract with no runtime instantiation.
findings.nextAction: Use a separate DSCP-T4 receipt runtime boundary roadmap only after Codex audit and operator authorization.

nextScanRecommendation: Audit DSCP-T3 closure before opening DSCP-T4. If authorized, DSCP-T4 should be receipt runtime boundary only, deterministic and provider-free unless a separate live-proof lane is authorized.
